create_world_graph: create a Graph instance to store entities and their spatial relations in a simulated world
add_nodes_and_edges: add nodes representing rooms furniture and objects then connect them with labeled directional edges
merge_two_graphs: merge another Graph into the current one adding new nodes and replacing existing node properties
query_graph_nodes: query the graph to find nodes by name sim handle or filter by entity class type
display_graph_hierarchy: display the graph hierarchy using DFS traversal printing rooms furniture receptacles and objects
